notes.winRate: Wins divided by wins plus losses; ties are tracked but excluded from win-rate denominator.
notes.metricEligibility: Metric calculations exclude standings where the player dropped on game 1 or game 2.
notes.usagePercent: Pokemon set slots with the move divided by total Pokemon set slots in this stats file scope.
notes.detailMinimum: Top Pokemon detail lists only include entries used on at least 3 teams in this stats file scope.
